caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a cup or container made from a natural material, possibly wood or bark, rendered in brown tones with lighter and darker areas to show texture and form. The vessel has an uneven, slightly flared rim with a few visible cracks and imperfections, indicating it is worn or aged. Attached to the upper left side is a handle or strap made from a twisted or braided cord, also rendered in light brown, and fastened through a pair of holes near the rim. The base of the object is accentuated with several horizontal ridges, giving it a ribbed appearance. The background is a plain off-white or cream color, and the artist's signature, "Mabel G. Claflin," is visible near the lower right corner.
title: Holy Water Font
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
